invariant_bindings.invariant_text: The shedder SHALL admit strictly by descending priority class and MUST NEVER admit a lower class while a higher class is being rejected.
A rejected request MUST be returned with an explicit overload signal (HTTP 503 or status UNAVAILABLE) and a retry-after hint.
The cutoff priority CANNOT change more than once per control_interval_ms to prevent oscillation.
A request that passed admission control SHALL NEVER be shed later in the pipeline.
The shedder MUST publish the current cutoff as a metric so clients can cooperate with backoff.
